crisis.title.draft: Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara na wowɔ hɔ

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara na wowɔ saa haw no mu. Ɛhɔ na bere nyinaa wuhu  —  frɛ anaa kyerɛw asɛm no 988, anaa 911 wɔ ahohia bere mu.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ mmara mu, ayaresa ne akwantu.

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Nhyehyɛe  —  a ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ no yiye. Sɛ wohwɛ no yiye a, wubehu nea wobɛyɛ wɔ nnɔnhwerew 24 a edi kan no mu. Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara na woayɛ saa.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Wɔakyerɛw wo nkrataa no mu nsɛm wɔ kratafa bi so.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Afei nso wobɛtumi aka Hwehwɛ mmoa seesei wɔ mfoni biara atifi hɔ.

reentry.call211.draft: Nhyiamu 211 a ɛfa amantam mmoa ho

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Hwehwɛ baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ hu a wubetumi akɔtena (frɛ 211 anaa baabi a wobɛtumi akɔtena)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Hwehwɛ aduan a ɛbɛso wo nnawɔtwe yi (frɛ 211 anaa baabi a wɔtɔn aduan wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ)

reentry.steps.step11.draft: Twe 988 ne 911 to wo fon so

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Kyerɛw bere a wobedi asɛm no nyinaa wɔ kalenda so

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Hwehwɛ asotwe, ho aka, ne sika a wobetua

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Fa wo ho hyɛ Medicaid mu, na sɛ ehia wo a, bɔ ho mmɔden

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Di kan ne wo polisifo no nsusuw nsɛm a ɛfa w'asotwe ho no ho ansa na woasrɛ.

phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Adwuma nketenkete a wɔyɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no. Hwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa bere a wobegyae adwuma no ho wɔ wo sraani no nkyɛn. Wɔmfa telefon nɔma nkyerɛ.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Wɔabɔ ka, nanso wonnya mmaa ho kwan.

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: Sika ho mfaso biara nni token no so.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Sika a wɔde sie ne fie nhyehyɛe a ɛfa ahotɔ ho. Groundwork mfa fie mma, na ɛne wɔn a wɔma nnoɔma no nni ayɔnkofa. Sɛ wuhia mmoa a, frɛ 211.
